title: PREpiBind: Protein Representation-integrated Epitope-MHC Class II Binding Prediction
description:
PREpiBind is a dual-stream, joint-attention framework for peptide–MHC class II binding prediction. It holds one downstream architecture fixed so that ten protein representations — a substitution matrix, structure-prediction-derived features and protein language models — can be compared on equal terms across qualitative binding, mass spectrometry and thresholded IC50 datasets.

This record archives the source snapshot of a tagged release: the model, the released checkpoint configurations and the inference CLI, the preprocessing, embedding and analysis pipelines, the scripts behind every figure, the IEDB-derived training and evaluation datasets, and a runnable demo.

Licensing is not uniform across this archive. The code is MIT. The data is not, and the record-level licence field cannot express the difference, so it is set to "Other (Open)". Per-file terms are in data/LICENSE.md and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md inside the archive:

  • IEDB-derived datasets — CC BY 4.0, modified from the mhc_ligand_full export of 21 April 2025.
  • IPD-IMGT/HLA chain sequences (release 3.59.0, via ANHIG/IMGTHLA) — CC BY-NoDerivs, redistributed by permission of Anthony Nolan granted 24 September 2026, on the condition that Anthony Nolan be contacted to review the agreement should this work become commercial or otherwise make profit. These are processed data and are not an official IPD-IMGT/HLA release. The alignment itself is not redistributed; pipeline/preprocess/fetch_mhc_alignment.py downloads it.
  • Murine H2 chains — UniProt, CC BY 4.0.
  • Vendored ESMC encoder source — MIT, © Chan Zuckerberg Biohub, licence travelling with prepibind/esmc/.

The raw model predictions behind every reported number, and the IEDB export the datasets were built from, are archived separately as a dataset record: 10.5281/zenodo.22857373. They are not in this archive because of their size, and because that record exists to identify the IEDB snapshot, which IEDB itself does not version.
